title: Shopper Support Academy — Tenure Settlement of Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Adjustments
content:
A mileage adjustment on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is settled by the tenure method, applied to the sum formed from the claimed amount (after any share applying to it) and any credits added to it. The method follows the shopper's contractor account in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts:

- for a shopper account at the **Gold level or above** (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date, the sum is **multiplied by 1.08 and rounded up to the cent**;
- for an account at the **Silver level or above** (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date, it is **multiplied by 1.04 and rounded down to the cent**;
- for **every other account** the sum stands as it is.

The figure that results is rounded once more to the cent half up and booked as the adjustment amount.

## Training questions

**Which records decide the method?** The account's level and first activation date on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record, counted in whole calendar months up to the handling date.

**A Gold account 30 months past activation?** Silver-or-above and within 12 to 35 months: multiplied by 1.04, rounded down.

**A Silver account 40 months past activation?** Neither condition is met: the sum stands.

## Hypothetical sums

| Account | Sum | Settled |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, 52 months | 4.63 | 4.63 multiplied by 1.08 is 5.0004, rounded up to 5.01 |
| Silver, 20 months | 4.63 | 4.63 multiplied by 1.04 is 4.8152, rounded down to 4.81 |
| Full-Service Shopper, 70 months | 4.63 | 4.63 |
